integrity: Finite exact integral chain computations and their inclusion matrices are reproducible by the embedded Python-standard-library verifier. The earlier scale-three homotopy type and antipodal last-stage observation are specifically excluded from the new contribution. Publication-priority uncertainty and the absence of independent validation are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The finding determines integral homology and inclusion homomorphisms for the 24-vertex truncated-cube shortest-path Rips filtration; it does not classify higher attaching maps or the scale-four homotopy type, Euclidean-metric filtrations, or higher-dimensional cube-connected-cycle graphs.
title: Complete integral graph-metric Rips persistence of the truncated cube
